note: Voice rules from the 2026-09-24 research (natural, casual, native copy in 24 languages, plus mul rules for every language). Each rule: a regex (regex, structure) or a literal (word, phrase) matched with its script's boundary; flags i (default) or m, im; scope spoken, headline, alt or casual limits it to those roles; min is the number of matches it needs; region lists the markets it is for; bad and good are the author's test lines. copyrules.lint_voice applies a language's rules to lines in that language. Calibration lines are in tests/data/voice_calibration.json.

rules.replacement: Cut the connector; use و, بس, or start a new short line.
rules.what: Essay connectors (علاوة على ذلك, بالإضافة إلى ذلك, من ناحية أخرى, في الختام, وبالتالي) are repeated filler in AI Arabic and do not occur in

rules.replacement: Use a real verb: فتحنا فرع جديد (dialect) or the MSA passive افتُتح.
rules.what: تم or يتم plus a verbal noun (تم افتتاح, يتم توصيل) is an auxiliary-verb calque of the English passive; Arabic uses the verb itself or the t
rules.why: تم or يتم plus a verbal noun (تم افتتاح, يتم توصيل) is an auxiliary-verb calque of the English passive; Arabic uses the verb itself or the true passive.
rules.evidence: قطار الترجمة (Bushra L.), https://translatrain.com/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A9/ (read); Ahmed Jameel, Common Errors in Arabic Language Translations, https://ae.linkedin.com/pulse/common-errors-arabic-language-ahmed-jameel (read)

rules.replacement: Use the verb: نوصّل طلبك, not نقوم بتوصيل طلبك.

rules.why: قام بـ plus a verbal noun pads a simple verb and reads as translated report prose.

rules.bad: Di era digital yang serba cepat ini, belanja online jadi kebutuhan.
rules.good: Pesan jam 9 pagi, paket sampai sore.

rules.replacement: state the fact
rules.what: Throat-clearing hook; the fact itself is the hook
rules.why: Throat-clearing hook; the fact itself is the hook.
rules.evidence: jekardah-writer hook-gokil framework (listed with Di era sekarang as filler openers)
rules.bad: Tahukah kamu, kopi paling enak diseduh 2 menit?
rules.good: Seduh 2 menit, jangan lebih.

rules.replacement: state the real distinction
rules.what: Indonesian form of 'not just X, it's Y'
rules.why: Indonesian form of 'not just X, it's Y'.

rules.bad: Ini bukan cuma sepatu, tapi gaya hidup.
rules.good: Solnya karet alam, tahan 2 tahun dipakai harian.

rules.replacement: the real date or quantity
rules.what: Urgency without a fact
rules.why: Urgency without a fact; copyrules only checks the English phrases.
rules.evidence: jekardah headline-variants patterns (manufactured urgency is a truth-contract violation)
rules.bad: Promo spesial, jangan sampai ketinggalan!
rules.good: Promo berlaku sampai 30 September, 23.59 WIB.

rules.replacement: keep one or two accents, or none
rules.what: Three or more slang markers in one short piece reads as a brand pretending to be young
rules.why: Three or more slang markers in one short piece reads as a brand pretending to be young.
rules.evidence: humanizer-id rules B and C (slang as accent, max 1 to 2 per paragraph; cites wordy.info on words that amuse from a friend and grate from a brand); jekardah tutur (2 to 5 signals in short text) and no-ai-slop (never sprinkle literally, jujurly, bestie, sih)
rules.bad: Bestie, sepatu ini literally slay banget, no cap!
rules.good: Sepatu ini ringan banget, cocok buat jalan jauh.

rules.replacement: one pronoun system per piece
rules.what: Mixing gue/lo with aku/kamu is the Indonesian honorific mismatch
rules.why: Mixing gue/lo with aku/kamu is the Indonesian honorific mismatch.
rules.evidence: humanizer-id rule D and cringe_patterns #3; jekardah hook-gokil framework (do not mix pronoun systems)
rules.bad: Gue udah coba, dan kamu harus coba juga.
rules.good: Aku udah coba, dan kamu harus coba juga.

rules.replacement: kamu with casual particles, or Anda without them
rules.what: Formal Anda next to yuk or banget mixes two registers in one line
rules.why: Formal Anda next to yuk or banget mixes two registers in one line.
rules.evidence: inference from humanizer-id rule D and copy.md's own id row (kamu casual, Anda for banks)
rules.bad: Yuk, Anda wajib coba menu baru kami!
rules.good: Yuk, cobain menu baru kami!

rules.replacement: cut
rules.what: Gen Alpha meme slang in adult or paid copy
rules.why: Gen Alpha meme slang in adult or paid copy.
rules.evidence: humanizer-id rule B and gaul_to_baku.md (avoid in serious or monetised content)
rules.bad: Diskon sigma buat kamu yang mewing!
rules.good: Diskon 20% buat pelajar, tunjukkan kartu.

rules.replacement: name the change

rules.why: Unsupported inflation.

rules.replacement: State Y directly and attach one fact; keep a contrast only when X is a real, named alternative

rules.why: Negative antithesis 'not X but Y' is the strongest measured Korean AI tell, stable across models and tasks
rules.evidence: epoko77-ai/im-not-ai C-8: 5.8 vs 0.6 per 1k eojeol (9.2x, G2=41.7, p<0.0001), 18x vs personal blogs, 12.1x at n=60, 11.8x task-matched; limleesol/stop-slop-ko binary-contrast rule. Caveat: 31 of 532 clean human texts use it, so im-not-ai needs 2+ in long text
rules.bad: 이건 커피가 아니라 휴식입니다.
rules.good: 점심 뒤 10분, 커피 한 잔으로 쉬어 가세요.

rules.replacement: Drop the 'beyond' clause and state Y, or write 'X만이 아니라 Y'

rules.why: Calque of 'beyond a mere X'; a scope-escalation slogan

rules.good: 반찬 여섯 가지에 국까지, 한 상 9,000원.

rules.replacement: Join subject and predicate: '필요한 것은 휴식이다' becomes '쉬어야 한다' or a concrete line

rules.why: Cleft calque of 'What matters is / What you need is'
rules.evidence: epoko77-ai/im-not-ai D-8: 0.09 human vs 0.92 AI per 1k eojeol (about 10x); '필요한 것은' 9 AI texts vs 0 human; 핵심은/관건은 variants 0.17 vs 1.49; limleesol/stop-slop-ko rule 4

rules.good: 이번 주말엔 푹 쉬고 오세요.

rules.why: Significance inflation and paradigm cliches

rules.why: English comma habit carried into Korean connective endings

rules.bad: 가볍지만, 튼튼합니다.
